productDescriptions.bubble_bunny_pink: A pink speech bubble with a bunny decoration.
productDescriptions.bubble_butter_chick: A butter-yellow speech bubble with a chick decoration.
productDescriptions.bubble_starry_cat: A deep violet speech bubble with a starry cat decoration.
productDescriptions.character_chinchilla: Fresh from a sand bath, it came to play. Before saying hello, it has to show off that fluffy fur.
productDescriptions.character_guinea_pig: It forgot where it hid its snack. Judging by those full cheeks, it can't be far away.
productDescriptions.character_monkey: It came to share a banana. It says it only took one bite on the way… so why is half gone?
productDescriptions.character_otter: It came to show off its favorite clam. You can look, but it will sulk if you take it.
productDescriptions.character_pig: It followed the smell of snacks and decided to stay. Now it thinks this is home.
productDescriptions.character_starlight_upalupa: This axolotl brought home a lost star and hugs it tight even while sleeping.
productDescriptions.character_tree: A little tree went out for a walk. Told to take a break, it started choosing where to put down roots.
productDescriptions.throwable_banana: The monkey shared this banana. We haven't had a chance to ask whether that was intentional.
productDescriptions.throwable_baseball: A red-stitched ball that squashes on impact and bounces away.
productDescriptions.throwable_bouncy_heart: A throwable heart that bounces as it flies.
productDescriptions.throwable_clam: The clam the otter carried everywhere. There's no pearl inside, just some lingering attachment.
productDescriptions.throwable_dujjonku: Its cocoa shell and green filling squash with a satisfying crunch.
productDescriptions.throwable_dust_bath_pouch: It's the chinchilla's bath sand. Throwing it probably isn't a hint that you need a wash.
productDescriptions.throwable_mini_paprika: A carefully saved snack. If you pick it up within three seconds after throwing it, that's fine, right?
productDescriptions.throwable_pork: A satisfyingly solid slap! By the way, has anyone seen the pig next door lately?
productDescriptions.throwable_snowflake: A snowflake that scatters into tiny crystal shards on impact.
productDescriptions.throwable_squeaky_duck: A duck throwing a duck. It probably isn't a family dispute.
productDescriptions.throwable_starlight_orb: Starlight packed into a little orb. Has anyone checked whether the sky is missing a star?
productDescriptions.throwable_timber: A tree throws a tiny tree. Perhaps we should check the family tree first.
productDescriptions.throwable_toy_cannon: A mini cannon throwable that fires a fuse-lit shell.
productDescriptions.throwable_wakkuball: Crunch! Enjoy the crisp sound as the Wakku Ball shatters into pieces.
